```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(UpSetR)
library(KEGGREST)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(enrichplot)
```

```{r}
# load KO tables
ar <- read.table("../../exploratory/data/A_rectalis_KOs.txt",
                 sep = "\t", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)[,1] |> unique()
bm <- read.table("../../exploratory/data/B_massiliensis_KOs.txt",
                 sep = "\t", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)[,1] |> unique()
bo <- read.table("../../exploratory/data/B_obeum_KOs.txt",
                 sep = "\t", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)[,1] |> unique()


# checks
length(ar); length(bm); length(bo)
head(ar)


```

```{r}
#UpSet plot
pdf("../figures/panels/fig5E_shared-ko-upset.pdf", width=7, height=5)

upset(
  fromList(list(
    `B. obeum` = bo,
    `B. massiliensis` = bm,
    `A. rectalis` = ar
  )),
  nsets = 3,
  sets = c("B. obeum","B. massiliensis","A. rectalis"),
  order.by = "freq",
  mainbar.y.label = "Shared KO count",
  sets.x.label = "Total KO per species"
)

dev.off()
```

```{r}
shared_BO_BM_not_AR <- intersect(bo, bm) |> setdiff(ar)
length(shared_BO_BM_not_AR)

write.table(shared_BO_BM_not_AR, "shared_BO_BM_not_AR.txt",
            quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
BO_BM_not_AR_annot <- read.table(
  "../../exploratory/data/BO_BM_not_AR_annot.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  header = FALSE,
  quote = "",

colnames(BO_BM_not_AR_annot) <- c("KO", "Function")
```

```{r}
# define a background universe = all KOs seen in any of the 3 genomes
background <- unique(c(bo, bm, ar))
length(background)

```
```{r}
# map KOs -> KEGG pathways using KEGGREST
# map BOTH the shared set and the background so enrichment has a proper universe.

# KEGG link table: KO -> pathway (named vector)
# KEGG link table
ko2path_all <- keggLink("pathway", "ko")

map_ko_to_tbl <- function(ko_vec, ko2path) {
  wanted <- ko2path[paste0("ko:", ko_vec)]
  wanted <- wanted[!is.na(wanted)]
  tibble(
    KO      = sub("^ko:",  "", names(wanted)),
    Pathway = sub("^path:","", unname(wanted))
  ) %>% distinct() %>% tidyr::drop_na(Pathway)
}

# tables
tbl_shared <- map_ko_to_tbl(shared_BO_BM_not_AR,     ko2path_all)
tbl_bg     <- map_ko_to_tbl(background, ko2path_all)

# add human-readable pathway names
path_names <- keggList("pathway")
path_name_tbl <- tibble(
  Pathway      = sub("^path:", "", names(path_names)),
  Pathway_Name = as.character(path_names)
)

tbl_shared <- tbl_shared %>% left_join(path_name_tbl, by = "Pathway")
tbl_bg     <- tbl_bg     %>% left_join(path_name_tbl, by = "Pathway")

# background mapping for enrichment
ko_path_tbl <- tbl_bg %>%
  select(KO, Pathway, Pathway_Name) %>%
  distinct()

# summary for bar plot
pathway_summary <- tbl_shared %>% count(Pathway_Name, sort = TRUE)

write.csv(tbl_shared,       "BO_BM_not_AR_KO_to_pathways.csv",    row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(pathway_summary,  "BO_BM_not_AR_pathway_summary.csv",   row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r}
pathway_summary %>%
  filter(!is.na(Pathway_Name)) %>%
  slice_max(n, n = 20) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Pathway_Name, n), y = n, fill = Pathway_Name)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "KEGG Pathway",
    y = "Shared KO Count"
  ) +
  scale_fill_discrete() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

```{r}
# enrichment
query <- shared_BO_BM_not_AR
background <- unique(c(bo, bm, ar))

TERM2GENE <- ko_path_tbl %>% select(Pathway, KO)
TERM2NAME <- ko_path_tbl %>% select(Pathway, Pathway_Name) %>% distinct()

ekegg <- enricher(query,
                  TERM2GENE = TERM2GENE,
                  TERM2NAME = TERM2NAME,
                  universe  = background,
                  pAdjustMethod = "BH")

ekegg_res <- as.data.frame(ekegg)
sum(ekegg_res$p.adjust < 0.05)

dotplot(ekegg, showCategory = 20,
        title = "Enriched KEGG pathways (BO ∩ BM \\ AR)")
ggsave("../figures/panels/fig5F_kegg-enrichment.svg", width = 6, height = 4)


```
